EXPLICIT (application/curation): AWS Open Data Sponsorship (2-yr term, needs AWS account - fleet-deferred), Google Public Dataset Program (BigQuery tabular), Azure Open Datasets/Planetary Computer (curated, geo/ML). fit_summary.p2p_decentralized: Distribution of PUBLIC artifacts only (datasets, app packages, snapshots). Durability frame: bytes live where someone pins/seeds them - WebTorrent/BitTorrent/Iroh = swarm-or-provider uptime; IPFS = pin-or-gone; S5/Sia = contract-backed while funded. Encryption is per-candidate: S5 FS = E2EE; MEGA = zero-knowledge; everything else in this class is public-by-default (transport encryption is NOT content privacy).
fit_summary.quant_ml_data_sources: Data SOURCES, not storage planes (trading-lane freeze untouched - catalog only). Cleanest licenses: EDGAR (public domain), UCI (~86% CC-BY), Binance Vision (no-key, as-is).
